例句

  1. James came to Japan eight years ago not only because he wanted to visit temples, but also because he had a Japanese girlfriend.
    James 八年前來日本，不只是因為他想參觀寺廟，也是因為他有一個日本女朋友。
  2. She speaks not only English but also French.
    她不只會說英文，也會說法文。
  3. He is not only kind but also funny.
    他不只親切，也很風趣。
  4. I went to Kyoto not only because I like old temples, but also because my friend lives there.
    我去京都不只是因為我喜歡古老的寺廟，也是因為我朋友住在那裡。
  5. This restaurant is popular not only with students but also with office workers.
    這家餐廳不只受學生歡迎，也受上班族歡迎。
  6. Not only my brother but also my sister plays the piano.
    不只我哥哥，我姊姊也會彈鋼琴。
  7. We visited not only Osaka but also Nara.
    我們不只去了大阪，也去了奈良。
  8. The hotel was not only cheap but also clean.
    那家旅館不只便宜，也很乾淨。
  9. The test was not only long but also difficult.
    那個考試不只很長，也很難。
  10. Ann studies Japanese not only because she likes anime, but also because she wants to work in Tokyo.
    Ann 學日文不只是因為她喜歡動畫，也是因為她想在東京工作。
  11. I chose this school not only because it is near my house, but also because it has a good library.
    我選這所學校不只是因為它離我家近，也是因為它有很好的圖書館。
  12. He not only cleaned his room but also washed the dishes.
    他不只打掃了他的房間，也洗了碗。
  13. My mother not only cooks well but also makes her own bread.
    我媽媽不只很會煮菜，也自己做麵包。
  14. I started learning English six years ago.
    我六年前開始學英文。
  15. The train left ten minutes ago.
    火車十分鐘前開走了。
  16. My grandfather died three years ago.
    我爺爺三年前過世了。
  17. We moved to Taipei a long time ago.
    我們很久以前搬到台北。
  18. I saw Tom at the station an hour ago.
    我一個小時前在車站看到 Tom。
  19. Did you call me five minutes ago?
    你五分鐘前有打電話給我嗎？
  20. Two weeks ago, we went camping in the mountains.
    兩個星期前，我們去山上露營。
  21. My parents met in Tokyo twenty years ago.
    我爸媽二十年前在東京認識。
  22. Ten years ago, this town didn't have a train station.
    十年前，這個小鎮沒有火車站。
  23. I visited Japan two years ago not only to see the cherry blossoms but also to eat sushi.
    我兩年前去日本，不只是為了看櫻花，也是為了吃壽司。
  24. A month ago, Tom lost not only his wallet but also his phone.
    一個月前，Tom 不只掉了錢包，也掉了手機。
  25. She came to Taiwan five years ago not only because she wanted to study Chinese, but also because she loved Taiwanese food.
    她五年前來台灣，不只是因為她想學中文，也是因為她很愛台灣菜。
  26. The bus was not only late but also full.
    公車不只誤點，還客滿了。
  27. Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised by the news.
    不只學生，老師也對這個消息很驚訝。
  28. Three days ago, I got a letter from my old friend.
    三天前，我收到老朋友寄來的一封信。
  29. He left Japan a year ago, but he still writes to his host family.
    他一年前離開日本，但是他還是會寫信給他的寄宿家庭。
  30. I like this park not only because it is quiet, but also because it has many trees.
    我喜歡這座公園，不只是因為它很安靜，也是因為它有很多樹。
